pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa bhikkhunūpassayaṃ nissāya yavakkhettaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.3: bhikkhuniyo uccāraṃpi passāvaṃpi saṅkāraṃpi vighāsaṃpi khette chaḍḍenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.4: athakho so brāhmaṇo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo amhākaṃ yavakkhettaṃ dūsessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa brāhmaṇassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo uccāraṃpi passāvaṃpi saṅkāraṃpi vighāsaṃpi harite chaḍḍessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo uccāraṃpi passāvaṃpi saṅkāraṃpi vighāsaṃpi harite chaḍḍentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.12: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo uccāraṃpi passāvaṃpi saṅkāraṃpi vighāsaṃpi harite chaḍḍessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā saṅkāraṃ vā vighāsaṃ vā harite chaḍḍeyya vā chaḍḍāpeyya vā pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.12: calakāni vā aṭṭhikāni vā ucchiṭṭhodakaṃ vā vuccati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.14: pubbaṇṇaṃ aparaṇṇaṃ yaṃ manussānaṃ upabhogaparibhogaṃ ropimaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.19: sakiṃ āṇattā bahukaṃpi chaḍḍeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.1: harite haritasaññā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.2: harite vematikā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.3: harite aharitasaññā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
